sql:
select
  t.name as tenant_name,
  jr.queued_at,
  jr.started_at,
  jr.finished_at,
  jr.error_message,
  jr.attempt
from job_runs jr
join jobs j on j.id = jr.job_id
join tenants t on t.id = jr.tenant_id
where j.handler = 'carts.remind'
  and jr.status = 'failed'
  and jr.queued_at >= date '2025-11-01'
  and jr.queued_at < date '2025-12-01'
order by jr.queued_at asc, t.name asc
note: One row per failed carts.remind job run in Nov 2025, with tenant, timing and error_message/attempt to spot shared vs. scattered root causes; expect 20 rows.
